status: R5.V6 frozen system-level mechanical and power contract

board_stack.vga_cable_exit: beyond the Video top board edge; slot 5 is the end position and slot 4 is deliberately empty in the first article
board_stack.orientation_keying: convention-only: matching pin-1 arrows and extension-row position; insertion power must be off

supply.overload: 110-150 percent rated power, hiccup, automatic recovery
supply.plug: P1J, 2.1 mm ID / 5.5 mm OD / 11 mm, center positive
supply.receipt_test_note: The published plus/minus 5 percent envelope is broader than a conservative TTL distribution corner. Qualify the delivered unit at the plug with a 1.351 A electronic load; reject it for this build below 4.90 V average or above 80 mV peak-to-peak.

normal_input.reverse_protection_topology: crowbar after F_MAIN: cathode VCC_BUS, anode GND_BUS; the qualified supply hiccups on a reversed plug while the PPTC limits a sustained fault

usb_service_input.purpose: single-card/service operation only; never credit it for the populated five-board machine
usb_service_input.isolation_topology: anode USB_FUSED, cathode VCC_BUS; blocks main-supply backfeed into USB-C

distribution.wire_link_construction: one insulated 22-AWG tinned-copper wire per footprint, soldered through both 1.0 mm holes; minimum 3 A bench rating
distribution.model_note: Copper solve credits only the base VCC/GND pair although the extension pair is populated in parallel. Connector loss uses one VCC and one GND contact at the individual card current.
